notes.title: Patch Update 1.04
notes.content:
Hello my friends!

A new patch is live, here what includes:

- Texts and GUI fixes

- Directional help for new quests

- Time Freeze ability bugs fixed

- Minor bug fixes 


Have fun! and if you have other feedback on what features you would like to see let us know!

- 

Also, we're working on:

- Camera Mode
- New upcoming DLC
- New unlockable items and weapons

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages - Soundtrack available and Patch 1.02!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!



The Soundtrack DLC is now available on Steam to purchase, check out the page!



It includes 50 pieces of music from the original game
[p align="start"](This Item will be updated with the release of every additional DLC.)



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]

Also Patch 1.02 is now available and includes:



Fixes for Chinese Traditional and Chinese Simplified translations

Fixes for Japanese and Korean

Minor bug fixes



A new patch is on the way too and will include several bug fixes based on your feedback,

thank you so much for the support and keep us updates in the forum!



https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!

Mai: Child of Ages is OUT NOW for Steam and soon for all Consoles!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink]


Check out the Release Trailer:  [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XaoJqPljos4&ab_channel=ChubbyPixel"][/dynamiclink]

- Embark on a journey through a vast world brimming with mysteries, where you’ll encounter strange characters and uncover their stories.

- Rewrite History – Bend time to your will and reshape the future according to your desires using Mai’s unique powers.



We’re also working on a new FREE DLC that is coming soon,It will include new areas to explore and power ups to unlock.

so make sure to stay tuned on our Discord and socials for the latest updates!

OUR DISCORD SERVERYOUTUBE CHANNEL

Also don't forget to add the Soundtrack to your wishlists! 
(coming next week)


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]



Also, if you have any feedback during your playthrough, don't hesitate to tell us on the discussion forum!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/
